---
title: "API"
---

## Superficie

| Método | Ruta | Autenticación | Descripción |
|--------|------|---------------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/links` | No | Crear enlace. |
| GET | `/api/v1/links/{code}` | No | Consultar metadatos. |
| GET | `/api/v1/links` | Admin | Listar con paginación. |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/links/{code}` | Admin | Cambiar estado o expiración. |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/links/{code}` | Admin | Desactivar lógicamente. |
| GET | `/api/v1/links/{code}/stats` | Admin | Métricas agregadas. |
| GET | `/api/v1/links/{code}/qr` | No | PNG del QR. |
| GET | `/s/{code}` | No | Redirección `307`. |
| POST | `/shorten` | No | Compatibilidad heredada. |
| GET | `/health` | No | Disponibilidad. |

Documentación interactiva: <http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs>.

## Envelope

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Enlace corto creado correctamente.",
  "data": {
    "short_code": "abc2345",
    "short_url": "http://localhost:8000/s/abc2345",
    "original_url": "https://www.example.com/articulo?lang=es",
    "qr_url": "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/links/abc2345/qr",
    "created_at": "2026-11-05T12:00:00+00:00",
    "expires_at": null,
    "is_active": true,
    "click_count": 0,
    "status": "active"
  },
  "errors": [],
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "5f0c...",
    "api_version": "1.0.0",
    "language": "es"
  }
}
```

## Crear enlace

```powershell
$body = @{ url = "https://www.example.com/articulo?lang=es" } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/links" `
  -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body
```

- `201` con `LinkData`.
- Código de 7 caracteres, sin deduplicación.
- `expires_at` opcional y futuro.
- Límite de 60 creaciones por 60 s.

## QR

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/links/abc2345/qr" -OutFile "qr.png"
```

El PNG codifica `http://localhost:8000/s/abc2345`, nunca la URL original.

## Administración

```powershell
$headers = @{ "X-Admin-API-Key" = "dev-admin-cambiar-en-produccion" }
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/links" -Headers $headers
```

- Sin cabecera: `401`.
- Clave incorrecta: `403`.
- Sin clave configurada: `503`.

## Errores

| Estado | Códigos |
|--------|---------|
| `400` | `invalid_url`, `invalid_scheme`, `invalid_host`, `embedded_credentials` |
| `401` | `admin_authentication_required` |
| `403` | `admin_forbidden` |
| `404` | `link_not_found` |
| `409` | `collision_unresolved` |
| `410` | `link_inactive`, `link_expired` |
| `422` | `invalid_payload`, `url_too_long`, `invalid_expiration` |
| `429` | `rate_limit_exceeded` |
| `500` | `persistence_failure`, `internal_error` |
| `503` | `admin_not_configured`, `service_unavailable` |
